text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer? Could I ask you for some 
advice? Actually—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Laurel-san! Doesn't this look 
super fun! Let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"'Exploding Fortune! A Day Trip to Power 
Spots'? Hehe, 'exploding' definitely 
catches the eye."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
They say if you visit them in the 
designated order, you get suuuper powered 
up! Aha☆ I can feel the Marvelous 
overflowing already★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, I wanna enjoy some 
grown-up gourmet food too~. Ah! And I 
deeeefinitely wanna go to a hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"And just like that, rather than visiting 
power spots, it's ended up feeling more 
like 'a little trip with the three of 
us'—"
choice_data_list:
Doing all of that in one day seems pretty 
tough...

Doing all of that in one day seems pretty 
tough...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I'm also worried they might 
push themselves too hard trying to grant 
every wish, ending up injured or getting 
lost...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I want to grant the wishes of 
those two. So—please, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Would you help me plan it and come along 
on the trip with me?!

If coming along can ease her burden, 
there's no reason to refuse. I resolved to 
do everything I could to make it a fun 
trip.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's the one... What you see over there 
is our first spot: the 'Mystic Waterfall'!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible☆ That roaring rumble is 
reverberating all the way over here★ 
Natural heavy bass is truly marvelous☆"
choice_data_list: Let's get a little closer and take a photo

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it, let's take it! ...Ah, but 
do we have enough time? If we take it too 
easy, won't we run out of time to see 
everything?

Sakura Laurel and I had researched 
thoroughly beforehand just for a moment 
like this. I gave her a firm, reassuring 
nod back, telling her everything would be 
fine.
choice_data_list:
We can take a shortcut by going down the 
river from here.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! You can do that?! Then taking a 
little extra time is totally fine. Let's 
get closer and soak up some power!

text_block_list.name: Mayano & Marvelous
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~! So fast, so fast, so faaast!! 
Ahahahaâ High-speed Marvelo~usâ

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, you two! That tree over there 
was listed as a recommended power spot, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Awesome! That rock is shaped just 
like a dragon!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wahaa~☆ A miracle woven by time and 
nature!? Or a coincidence!? 
Marveloooous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how long it took to form that 
shape... Thousands of years? Tens of 
thousands? Maybe even longer? It kind of 
makes your head spin, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Every single power spot was 
wonderful. I feel like my body has gotten 
so much lighter.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Laurel-san, what are we doing 
next? Maya might be getting a little 
hungry~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave it to me, Maya-chan. Our tour 
of power spots is over, but the real fun 
is just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
We can take the cable car up ahead to 
reach the hot spring town on the other 
side of the mountain. Let's enjoy lunch 
and the hot springs there!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha☆ Amazing! A whole mountain of fun, 
simply marvelous★

After finishing lunch, at the request of 
Mayano Top Gun and Marvelous Sunday, we 
decided to take a stroll through the hot 
spring town.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's great. Both of them look 
like they're having fun.
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You're not tired, are you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, there was so much packed into today, 
so I'd be lying if I said I wasn't tired 
at all, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
More than that, though, I'm having so much 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I was completely overwhelmed by the 
majesty of nature, and I got totally 
carried away during the river rafting."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
We were able to share such a fun 
experience together. When I think of that, 
all my physical fatigue just blows away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you two! They're doing a pottery 
workshop over there!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Who's gonna make the most marvelous one? I 
wonder who, I wonder who~☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A pottery-making experience... It sounds 
perfect for making wonderful memories.
choice_data_list: Still, the train ride back is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"We'll manage that part ourselves. Since 
it's a special trip, I want her to be able 
to do everything she wants to do. Right?♪"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We're heeere☆ Ehehe, we found sooo many 
Marvelous things today★☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya had tons of fun too! Let's all go out 
together again sometime, Laurel-san and 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's definitely go. You two, don't 
stay up late tonight and go to bed early, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, we somehow managed to see it 
through, didn't we?
choice_data_list: Good work. You worked hard today.
Good work. You worked hard today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Do you truly think so?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'd like a little reward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...May I stop by the trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da~, please take a look at this. These 
are sweets I bought in the hot spring 
town♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It was a bit pricey and limited edition. 
...Keep it a secret from Maya-chan and the 
others, okay?
choice_data_list:
Well then, I'll have to brew some 
delicious tea.

Well then, we should brew some delicious 
tea.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you very much! As a fitting 
end to our trip, let's take it easy and 
savor the lingering memories together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's get plenty of sugar and fully 
recharge our energy♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's white bean paste and 
red bean paste, so let's play 
rock-paper-scissors for them later.
